title: Security Council LIVE: Can new technology keep the world’s sea lanes safe?
summary: Cheap drones, autonomous vessels and cyberattacks are changing the threats to the world’s shipping lanes – and the tools to counter them. title: Ending conflict is ‘number one thing’ to reduce world hunger, new WFP chief says

title: Protecting the storytellers: Women journalists on the frontline of conflict

title: Record heat-related deaths in 2023, WHO-partnered report finds

title: Ocean’s ability to absorb carbon is weakening as climate change intensifies, UN warns
summary: The ocean absorbs around 30 per cent of human-caused carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions and 90 per cent of excess heat trapped by greenhouse gases. But climate change has already reduced its capacity to absorb carbon by approximately six per cent, a new UN report warns ahead of the COP31 climate conference in November.

title: General Assembly weighs US embargo against Cuba ahead of 34th vote
